up: Retrieve IC50 activity values for tylophorine and its salt forms against the RAW264.7 cell line. Join molecule_hierarchy to capture all salt/derivative molecules (children) of the parent compound tylophorine. Filter activities for standard_type = 'IC50'. Match the assay target/cell line to 'RAW264.7'. Return the compound preferred name, IC50 value, IC50 units, and the cell line name for each activity record. Do not apply additional filters on confidence scores or document types.
sql:
WITH tylophorine_parent AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE LOWER(pref_name) = 'tylophorine'
),
tylophorine_set AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM molecule_hierarchy
  WHERE parent_molregno IN (SELECT molregno FROM tylophorine_parent)
  UNION
  SELECT molregno FROM tylophorine_parent
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.pref_name AS compound_name,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_value,
  a.standard_units AS ic50_units,
  cd.cell_name AS cell_line_name
FROM activities a
JOIN tylophorine_set ts ON a.molregno = ts.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN cell_dictionary cd ON ass.cell_id = cd.cell_id
WHERE
  a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND cd.cell_name = 'RAW264.7';
